This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be 
 performed every one year as indicated by (Y1) in the above title block.

This pump is used to suction the sludge wasting water from the waste 
 clarifiers and discharged it in the sludge thickener.

 2008 revised by MDEP Co. Quality control Eng. Magdy Hegazy, accepted by 
 Eng . Magdy Okba, and approved by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Mageed Sowan.

This document accepted by Eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; MEPC inspection & quality 
 control general Manager& MPIS coordinator, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Nageeb 
 inspection & quality control's head sector.

The check must be carried out be qualified and competent

Open the valves and vents and close drain .

filling the pump casing with the medium , in case of high

 lubrication of the rubber stator.

 performed every one year as indicated by (Y1) in the above title block.
This pump is used to suction the sludge wasting water from the waste 
 clarifiers and discharged it in the sludge thickener.

 Eng . Magdy Okba, and approved by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Mageed Sowan.
This document accepted by Eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; MEPC inspection & quality

Starting the Pump
Before starting the pump, the following steps 
should be checked
Check the direction of rotation of motor before starting; it 
 is clockwise
The check must be carried out be qualified and competent 
 operators , starting the motor for a few second
Open the valves and vents and close drain .
filling the pump casing with the medium , in case of high 
 viscosity media fill with the liquid .Pump priming is vital to ensure 
 lubrication of the rubber stator.
